scheme_name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme- Differently-abled and Posthumously
other_conditions: Applicant must be a bonafide native of Uttar Pradesh.

Must have been a member of the state senior team for at least three consecutive years (e.g., 2018‑19, 2019‑20, 2020‑21) and participated in the National Games/National Senior Championship, earning a medal in the year for which the award is recommended.

Participation in the National Senior Championship plus participation in any listed international competition (Olympic Games, World Championship/World Cup, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Asian Championship, Commonwealth Championship, SAF Games) makes the applicant eligible.
Must submit an affidavit stating never used drugs in any competition and an oath confirming no criminal conviction, including no sexual harassment findings.
Only one award per person; the award may be given posthumously.
Players who have only participated in National Senior Championships/National Games without the additional criteria are not eligible.
For the Veteran category, the applicant must be 40 years or older on 1 April of the award year.
Veteran category applicants may be from any two of the designated 31 sports and must have achieved significant achievements in National Championships or International Competitions.
benefits_summary: Citation, bronze statue, scroll, and cash prize of ₹3,11,000.
documents_required: Oath confirming no criminal conviction or sexual harassment
